e-Caraka

A reading edition of the Carakasaṃhitā, in IAST

The Carakasaṃhitā, a Sanskrit treatise on medicine, is organized into eight sthānas (sections). It is read here alongside Cakrapāṇidatta's commentary, the Āyurvedadīpikā, with the two distinguished typographically. Choose a sthāna below to browse its adhyāyas (chapters).

Sūtrasthānam

30 adhyāyas
Sthāna 2

8 adhyāyas
Sthāna 3

Vimānasthānam

8 adhyāyas

8 adhyāyas

Indriyasthānam
